sources.title: Propel homepage
sources.claim: Balance in seconds; transaction details incl. store names and online purchases; deposit alerts; card lock, suspicious-activity monitoring, out-of-state and online blocking; offers (groceries, phone plans, utilities, car insurance, healthcare); local jobs; SNAP/WIC policy-change alerts; 5+ million users; 49 states + DC + PR, USVI, Guam; not available in Iowa; free, ad/partner funded.
caveats: Only copyright year 2026 shown; brief source S12.
Marketing claims (user counts, '#1') not independently verified.
sources.local_note: Homepage: 49 states, DC, PR, USVI, Guam; not available in Iowa; free app funded by advertising and partner offers; you don't need to call a 1-800 number or log in to a state website.

sources.title: Propel FAQ
sources.claim: Supported in 49 states, DC, PR, USVI, Guam; Iowa balance checking not available. Connects to state systems with credentials the state requires (may include SSN); does not store PIN, full card number or SSN; cannot access PIN and cannot spend or move benefits; SNAP, WIC and TANF balances in one place; free; revenue from advertising and partnerships; independent tech company (since 2014), not government; does not sell personal info; deletion via help@propel.app.
caveats: No visible update date.
Deposit-date estimate not covered on FAQ.
sources.local_note: FAQ: 'No, we're an independent tech company.' 'We can't access your PIN, and we can't spend or move your benefits.' Iowa listed as not supported for balance checking.

sources.title: Propel's EBT security features
sources.page_scope: Security feature article with per-state lists (brief S14)
sources.claim: Card lock, out-of-state blocking, online blocking, suspicious-transaction monitoring (Propel exclusive), Alabama high-risk transaction blocking; each with an explicit state list; PIN/full card/SSN not stored; encrypted.
caveats: State lists differ per feature; Iowa absent from all lists.
Card lock list includes AL but not LA/AR/CT/IN/MS/TX/PR/IA; out-of-state list includes LA but not AL.
Online blocking list excludes AL, DE, GA, LA, MD, MA, NJ, OH, OK, PA, SC, UT, VA, etc.
sources.local_note: Lock: AL AK AZ CA CO DE DC FL GA GU HI ID IL KS KY MA MD ME MI MN MO MT NE NV NH NJ NM NY NC ND OH OK OR PA RI SC SD TN UT VT VI VA WA WV WI WY. Out-of-state: AK AZ CA CO DE DC FL GA GU HI ID IL KS KY LA MD ME MI MN MO MT NE NV NH NJ NM NY NC ND OH OK OR PA RI SC SD TN UT VT VI VA WA WV WI WY. Online: AK AZ CA CO DC FL GU HI ID IL KS KY ME MI MN MO NE NV NH NM NY NC ND OR RI SD TN VT VI WA WV WI WY. Suspicious monitoring: AL AZ AR CA CO CT DE FL GA GU IL IN KS KY LA MD ME MI MS NJ NY OH OK PA PR SC TN TX UT VA. High-risk: Alabama only, auto-enabled, blocks out-of-state and online, user can turn off.

sources.title: Balance checking
sources.claim: Balance, spending and deposits instantly; transaction history; deposit status 'pending, on the way, landing'; toggles to block out-of-state and online transactions.
caveats: Mentions only SNAP/EBT; no WIC/TANF specifics.
Footer lists all states as state guides, not as supported-state list.
sources.local_note: Know when your deposit is pending, on the way, and landing in your account. Easily access your transaction history.

sources.title: Security benefits
sources.claim: Lock/unlock card; block out-of-state and web/app transactions; alerts on suspicious activity (Propel exclusive) with confirmation UI mockup; links theft education; EBT theft estimated $400M/year.
caveats: No per-state availability on this page; see CR-PR-03.
sources.local_note: Get alerts when Propel sees suspicious transaction activity on your card. Lock and unlock your card easily.

sources.title: Offers
sources.claim: Curated offers for EBT users across groceries, phone plans, utilities, healthcare; 'We check every company and every deal.'
caveats: No partner names, eligibility or fees listed.
No advertiser-compensation disclosure on this page.
sources.local_note: All of our deals and offers are selected with one question in mind: Would this be helpful for our users? Categories: groceries, phone plans, utilities, healthcare.

sources.title: Propel Privacy Policy
sources.claim: Collects EBT portal usernames/passwords to link accounts; SSN transmitted through server to create portal accounts but not stored; card number and PIN not saved (last four may be stored); no sale of personal info; no cross-site targeted ad tracking; deletion via support/help@propel.app with identity confirmation; no knowing collection under 13.
caveats: Direct URL https://www.propel.app/privacy-policy/ returned ECONNRESET; in-app policy URL fetched instead.
sources.local_note: We do not store your SSN on our systems; transmitted through our server. Designed to function without saving EBT card number or PIN. Propel does not sell your personal information to any third party.

sources.title: Propel Terms of Service
sources.claim: Linking authorizes Propel to connect to the state Portal on user's behalf as agent; Portals provide government-generated info and Propel is not responsible for its accuracy; alerts may be delayed or prevented; Propel accesses Portal only while user uses the Service; unlink to stop access; third-party content disclaimer.
caveats: Terms do not explicitly say 'not a government agency' (that is in FAQ CR-PR-02 and App Store CR-PR-13).
sources.local_note: By linking your Propel Account to a Portal, you authorize Propel to connect to the Portal on your behalf as your agent. Alerts may be delayed or prevented.

sources.title: California food stamp deposit schedule
sources.claim: CalFresh issued days 1-10 by last digit of case number; ~92% of Propel users see benefits loaded at midnight (Propel user data); if not loaded, wait before contacting county.
caveats: Dated 2024; schedules change.
Midnight-load share is Propel-derived, not official.
sources.local_note: CalFresh benefits are sent out over the first 10 days of every month, based on the last digit of your case number. About 92% of people have their benefits loaded at midnight in California.

sources.title: Stop EBT theft hub
sources.claim: Theft-trend insights, blog education, email sign-up for theft updates.
caveats: Date is latest listed report, not page update.
sources.local_note: Hub for EBT theft insights and strategies to protect benefits; sign up for email alerts on theft updates.

sources.title: EBT theft: how it happens and replacing stolen benefits
sources.claim: Skimming and phishing explained; report theft to state EBT hotline; federal replacement ended Dec 20, 2024; California and Maryland continue state-level reimbursement; use card lock and blocking.
caveats: State reimbursement status may have changed since Nov 2025.
sources.local_note: Federal reimbursement for stolen benefits ended December 20, 2024. California and Maryland continue state-level reimbursement. Report theft to your state's EBT hotline.

sources.title: What is the Propel app and how does it work
sources.claim: Accesses EBT account info with permission through state EBT systems; user selects state and enters EBT login credentials; does not request PIN or full card number; 'Not every security feature is available in every state.'
caveats: Older (Mar 2025); no explicit state exception list.
sources.local_note: The Propel app accesses your EBT account information with your permission through your state's EBT systems. Not every security feature is available in every state.

sources.title: Propel: EBT, SNAP, WIC, & more (App Store)
sources.claim: EBT and WIC balances and spending history; card lock, out-of-state/online blocking, suspicious monitoring (availability varies by state); EBT, WIC, Child Tax Credit, TANF in one place; deals; job board (gigs to full-time); updates on SNAP, Summer EBT, disability; 53 states and territories incl. DC, PR, USVI, Guam; 'Propel, Inc. is a private company'; contains ads; v9.4.0; 4.9 stars.
caveats: Listing showed 'updated 2 days ago' (relative); ratings counts differ between fetch (604K) and search snippet (486K).
sources.local_note: App Store: security tools availability varies by state; operates in 53 states and territories; Propel, Inc. is a private company; job board; version 9.4.0.

sources.title: Benefits updates
sources.claim: Proactive in-app alerts about changes to SNAP and WIC benefits written by policy experts; e.g. SNAP work requirements 2025.
caveats: Delivery channel details (push vs in-app) not specified.
sources.local_note: Know when there are changes to your benefits and what they mean for you; resources written by policy experts.

sources.title: Free tablet with EBT (Lifeline/ACP)
sources.claim: ACP ended June 1, 2024 (no new funding); Lifeline up to $9.25/month federal, enhanced in some states (CA up to $19; OR $19.25 internet/$15.25 phone); SNAP recipients automatically qualify; some providers offer free smartphones (TruConnect CA, Access Wireless OR, Assurance/Safelink NJ, Safelink NY).
caveats: Education content; not proof that the app itself enrolls users in Lifeline.
sources.local_note: ACP benefits ended June 1, 2024. Lifeline provides up to $9.25 monthly discount; you automatically qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI or Federal Public Housing Assistance.

sources.title: Can I look at my EBT transactions online
sources.claim: Propel shows EBT transaction details including store names, dates, amounts; works with EBT cards 'nationwide'; retailer info may not show in some states' vendor apps.
caveats: 'Nationwide' wording conflicts with Iowa exclusion elsewhere.
sources.local_note: See EBT transaction details including store names, dates, and amounts. A free app in English and Spanish that works with EBT cards nationwide.

sources.title: Iowa EBT guide
sources.claim: State guide promotes Propel for Iowa balance checking, deposits and security features.
caveats: Generic template copy; conflicts with FAQ/homepage Iowa exclusion.
sources.local_note: Iowa guide: Propel is the best way to see upcoming deposits, check your EBT balance, and turn on security features.

sources.title: Montana EBT guide
sources.claim: State guide promotes Propel for Montana balance checking, deposits and security features.
caveats: Generic template copy; conflicts with CR-PR-19 Montana exclusion.
sources.local_note: Montana guide: Propel is the best way to see upcoming deposits, check your EBT balance, and turn on security features.

sources.title: Propel landing page (paid search)
sources.claim: Supports EBT programs in 52 states and territories incl. SNAP and Summer EBT; works in every state except Iowa and Montana plus DC, PR, USVI, Guam; free phones, discounted internet, grocery savings; job & gig opportunities; ad-funded and selective.
caveats: Campaign page; conflicts with homepage (49 states, only Iowa excluded) and App Store (53).
sources.local_note: It works in every U.S. state except Iowa and Montana and is also available in Washington D.C., Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Guam. Job & gig opportunities that fit your schedule.
